performance.scope: Envelope-only same-machine Chromium probe; baseline freezes the original backup and worker modules from the recorded commit. Repeated actual serialized text is synthetic and NOT a valid long Runtime save; formal load deliberately stops at an explicit sentinel. Measures JSON/envelope work plus its dispatch, not complete import, real long story, phone performance or total speedup. Cancellation uses an actual in-flight CPU Worker, without delayed replies; exact CPU instruction at abort is not observed.

scope: Existing backup envelope JSON/UTF-8/hash/base64/preview work moved to cancellable CPU-only one-shot Worker messages. Full session validation and metadata comparison remain mandatory before showing an import target; atomic import writes unchanged. Worker-unavailable fallback retains synchronous cost. Same format, unchanged Core/Runtime/story/media, exact old backup byte round trip, native tasks, held real reply cancellation and explicit retry, exact newly authored game pair. Envelope stress contains repeated serialized text, NOT a valid long Runtime story. Main-thread dispatch/clone, full validation/snapshot reconstruction, underlying IO/long writes, natural listening, physical phones/Safari/OS background/BFCache, embedded WebKit/offline audio, rights/public HTTPS and long-soak acceptance remain open.
